svg.desc: CEZ Job Finder mark, bare blackbird (male common blackbird, Turdus merula: all black, yellow beak + eye ring - keep both at every size; "the first one up"), master for large uses (share cards). Facing right; 8-unit grid: head r48 at 160,56, breast r64 at 128,136, wing + tail one 45 deg band 24 wide, nape, throat r48, tail end one raked cut, legs 16 wide cut at y=248, beak one wedge w/ its root on the head's own curve + a rounded tip at 239,56, eye ring r11 at 156,36. Contract (app/docs/desktop-icon.md): viewBox 0 0 256 256, shapes direct children of the svg, each w/ a class - ink (#000000), beak + eye (#ffe433), pupil (#000000) - and a plain fill attribute; no id, style, defs, group or transform.
